source: CPTS Module 03: Network Enumeration with Nmap
notes:
auth       bypass/enumerate authentication
broadcast  discover hosts via broadcast
brute      credential brute forcing
default    run with -sC
discovery  enumerate services/network
dos        denial of service (dangerous)
exploit    actively exploit a vuln
external   uses third-party services
fuzzer     send randomized fields
intrusive  may crash/alert the target
malware    detect backdoors
safe       non-disruptive
version    version-detection helpers
vuln       check for known vulns

references.title: HTB Academy - Network Enumeration with Nmap

name: Reference - NSE Script Categories
description: The NSE script categories you can pass to --script. safe = non-disruptive; intrusive/dos/exploit can crash or attack the target.
